from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import sys

import pymupdf
from aspose.words_foss import light_document_model as ldm
from aspose.words_foss.pdf_writer import LdmPdfWriter
from aspose.words_foss.saving import PdfSaveOptions

CASES = {'arabic-word': ['س', 'لام'], 'arabic-latin': ['سلام ', 'ABC', ' عالم ', 'DEF', ' نهاية'],
         'rtl-numbers': ['سلام ', '(', '123', ')', ' عالم'],
         'latin-kerning': ['A', 'V', 'A', 'T', 'A', 'R'],
         'mixed': ['中文 ', 'hello ', 'سلام ', '123 ', '世界']}

def render(parts, shaping):
    model = ldm.Document(sections=[ldm.Section(page_setup=ldm.PageSetup(page_width=400,
        page_height=250, left_margin=20, right_margin=20, top_margin=20, bottom_margin=20),
        body=ldm.Body(children=[ldm.Paragraph(children=[ldm.Run(text=text,
            font=ldm.Font(size=28)) for text in parts])]))])
    options = PdfSaveOptions()
    options.text_shaping = shaping
    options.fallback_fonts = ['/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/Arial.ttf']
    raw = LdmPdfWriter(options).write_to_bytes(model)
    with pymupdf.open(stream=raw, filetype='pdf') as doc:
        result={'text':doc[0].get_text(),'words':doc[0].get_text('words'),
                'pixels_sha256':hashlib.sha256(doc[0].get_pixmap(matrix=pymupdf.Matrix(2,2)).samples).hexdigest()}
        return result

results = {'probe_source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'cases':{}}
for name,parts in CASES.items():
    whole = render([''.join(parts)], True)
    split = render(parts, True)
    results['cases'][name]={'whole':whole,'split':split,'same_pixels':whole['pixels_sha256']==split['pixels_sha256']}
Path(f'/tmp/docweave-shaping-split-{sys.argv[1]}.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({name:{'whole_text':r['whole']['text'],'split_text':r['split']['text'],'same_pixels':r['same_pixels']} for name,r in results['cases'].items()},ensure_ascii=False))

         'latin-kerning': ['A', 'V', 'A', 'T', 'A', 'R'],
         'mixed': ['中文 ', 'hello ', 'سلام ', '123 ', '世界']}

def render(parts, shaping, native=False):
    model = ldm.Document(sections=[ldm.Section(page_setup=ldm.PageSetup(page_width=400,
        page_height=250, left_margin=20, right_margin=20, top_margin=20, bottom_margin=20),
        body=ldm.Body(children=[ldm.Paragraph(children=[ldm.Run(text=text,
            font=ldm.Font(size=28)) for text in parts])]))])
    options = PdfSaveOptions()
    options.text_shaping = shaping
    options.fallback_fonts = ['/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/Arial.ttf']
    if native:
        pdf = FPDF(format=(400 * PT_TO_MM, 250 * PT_TO_MM))
        pdf.set_margins(20 * PT_TO_MM, 20 * PT_TO_MM, 20 * PT_TO_MM)
        pdf.set_auto_page_break(True, margin=20 * PT_TO_MM)
        register_fonts(pdf, model, options.fallback_fonts)
        pdf.set_text_shaping(shaping)
        pdf.add_page()
        pdf.set_font('DocumentSansSC', size=28)
        pdf.multi_cell(pdf.epw, 28 * 1.4 * PT_TO_MM, ''.join(parts))
        raw = bytes(pdf.output())
        close_fonts(pdf)
    else:
        raw = LdmPdfWriter(options).write_to_bytes(model)
    with pymupdf.open(stream=raw, filetype='pdf') as doc:
        pixmap=doc[0].get_pixmap(matrix=pymupdf.Matrix(2,2))
        pixmap.save(f'/tmp/docweave-shaping-inspection-{native}.png')

                'pixels_sha256':hashlib.sha256(doc[0].get_pixmap(matrix=pymupdf.Matrix(2,2)).samples).hexdigest()}
        return result

results = {'probe_source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'cases':{}}
for name,parts in CASES.items():
    whole = render([''.join(parts)], True)
    split = render(parts, True)
    native = render([''.join(parts)], True, native=True)
    results['cases'][name]={'whole':whole,'split':split,'native':native,
        'same_pixels':whole['pixels_sha256']==split['pixels_sha256'],
        'native_same_pixels':whole['pixels_sha256']==native['pixels_sha256']}
Path(f'/tmp/docweave-shaping-split-{sys.argv[1]}.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({name:{'whole_text':r['whole']['text'],'split_text':r['split']['text'],'same_pixels':r['same_pixels'],'native_same_pixels':r['native_same_pixels']} for name,r in results['cases'].items()},ensure_ascii=False))

import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import resource
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
import time

import pymupdf
from aspose.words_foss import light_document_model as ldm
from aspose.words_foss.pdf_writer import LdmPdfWriter
from aspose.words_foss.saving import PdfSaveOptions

ROOT = '/Users/sheny/Developer/code/Aspose.Words-FOSS-for-Python'

if len(sys.argv) > 1:
    text = '12345' * 80
    parts = text if sys.argv[1] == 'fragmented' else [text]
    model = ldm.Document(sections=[ldm.Section(body=ldm.Body(children=[ldm.Paragraph(
        children=[ldm.Run(text=part, font=ldm.Font(size=14)) for part in parts])]))])
    options = PdfSaveOptions()
    options.text_shaping = True
    tick = time.perf_counter()
    raw = LdmPdfWriter(options).write_to_bytes(model)
    elapsed = time.perf_counter() - tick
    with pymupdf.open(stream=raw, filetype='pdf') as pdf:
        assert ''.join(page.get_text() for page in pdf).replace('\n', '').replace(' ', '') == text
        pages = len(pdf)
    print(json.dumps({'seconds':elapsed,'pdf_bytes':len(raw),'pages':pages,
        'rss_bytes':resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,
        'model_sha256':hashlib.sha256(model.model_dump_json().encode()).hexdigest()}))
else:
    results = {'python':sys.version,'platform':sys.platform,'scope':'PDF write-to-bytes only, imports/model creation excluded; independent processes, 5 alternating pairs per case',
        'probe_source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'cases':{}}
    for case in ['fragmented','whole']:
        runs = {'before':[],'after':[]}
        for i in range(5):
            for kind in (['before','after'] if i%2 == 0 else ['after','before']):
                env = os.environ.copy()
                env.pop('PYTHONPATH',None)
                if kind == 'after':env['PYTHONPATH']=ROOT
                sample = json.loads(subprocess.check_output([sys.executable,__file__,case],env=env,cwd='/tmp',text=True))
                runs[kind].append(sample)
        assert len({r['model_sha256'] for samples in runs.values() for r in samples}) == 1
        assert len({r['pages'] for samples in runs.values() for r in samples}) == 1
        results['cases'][case]={'samples':runs,'medians':{kind:{metric:statistics.median(r[metric] for r in samples) for metric in ['seconds','pdf_bytes','rss_bytes']} for kind,samples in runs.items()}}
    Path('/tmp/docweave-shaping-benchmark.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps({name:result['medians'] for name,result in results['cases'].items()}))
